baseline_kind_disclaimer: This is the qmirror standard reference baseline (4 stored Braket fixtures reproduced byte-identical), NOT anima-14B's actual hidden-state phi-star measured via projection. Future work plumbs anima-14B forward-pass -> 4q amplitude encoding -> qmirror iit, then computes the ratio against this baseline.

candidate_cond_9.definition_caveat: phi_star=0.0 baseline makes a literal ratio undefined (0/0). When mirror measurement comes online, the operationalized form is: ratio := phi_star(mirror) / max(phi_star(baseline), epsilon) where epsilon=1e-6, OR — preferred — re-anchor baseline against a non-trivial fixture (e.g. anima-14B 4q projection on a live pyphi engine) before declaring cond.9 evaluable. See cond9_spec.md.
